title: An Integrally Closed Reduced Ring with McCoy Localizations That Is Neither McCoy nor Locally a Domain
summary: We construct an explicit commutative ring $R$ that is reduced and integrally closed, such that $R_{\mathfrak p}$ is an integrally closed McCoy ring for every maximal ideal $\mathfrak p$ of $R$, while $R$ itself is not a McCoy ring and is not locally a domain. This gives an affirmative answer to Problem~9 in \emph{Open Problems in Commutative Ring Theory}.
